display.title: Episode 437: The Stone for the Beis HaMikdash (The Three Weeks)
display.summary_short: A Three Weeks show without music: Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa's stone for the Beis HaMikdash, a letter and Shavuos picture from two listeners, and an apple on three toothpicks.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in the middle of the Three Weeks of 5750, without music. Uncle Yossi explains that the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed for lack of Ahavas Yisroel, so these days are a time to strengthen love for one another. Story time begins with Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa, too poor to bring a gift for the Beis HaMikdash, praying by the roadside. A young Tzivos Hashem member recites the Shema in Studio 604. The story continues: Rabbi Chanina finds a perfectly square stone fit for a cornerstone but cannot move it, until five angels disguised as travelers offer help, and it floats to Yerushalayim only once he puts his little finger under it. Each mitzvah we do adds a stone to the third Beis HaMikdash, and if you try your best, Hashem will do the rest. After tzedakah and a word on Avraham Avinu's kindness, Uncle Yossi reads a letter from two Beis Yaakov students and describes their Shavuos picture of Har Sinai. He then explains, with the Alter Rebbe's parable of parents' joy, why baseless hatred caused the Churban, and closes with an experiment: an apple stands only on three toothpicks, as the world stands on Torah, avodah and gemilus chasadim.
display.lesson: Every mitzvah adds a stone to the third Beis HaMikdash; try your best and Hashem will do the rest.

date.note: 'Middle of the Three Weeks'; candle time 7:59 PM fits Fri 27 July 1990; one week after episode 436. The talk's 'as the coming month of Av arrives' may be reused.
